item.title: Dolby says Dolby Vision 2 HDR should come to cheaper TVs than the original — and the basic version is less expensive to license than Dolby Vision 2 Max to achieve that
item.description: Dolby Vision 2 Max replaces Dolby Vision 1, while Dolby Vision 2 is meant for a new breed of budget TV — and Dolby says its the best-value picture upgrade that manufacturers can get.

item.title: Ukraine's new secret drone weapon could be this 25g antenna, capable of transmitting over an incredible range
item.description: Ukraine's BlueBird Tech unveils lightweight antenna for drones, monitoring equipment, measurement systems, and ground-based robotic platforms.

item.title: I tested a cheap Dolby Atmos 5.1 soundbar system with real speakers — here’s where it impressed me, and where it fell short of the competition
item.description: The Ultimea Poseidon D60 is an affordable Dolby Atmos soundbar system, but it doesn’t come without a few trade-offs.

item.title: There's a sneaky way to watch UFC 330 for $1
item.description: We've found a sneaky way to stream UFC 330 virtually for free, as Islam Makhachev faces Ian Machado Garry and Mackenzie Dern meets Gillian Robertson.
